name: Alchemist
headline: Alchemist social media success bot
short_description: Alchemist is a bot that automates social media scheduling by endlessly recycling content from a Google Sheets library through Buffer, keeping profiles active without manual effort.
author: tomiwaAdey

sections.overview:
Alchemist is a social media automation bot that turns Buffer, a free scheduling tool, into a powerful content recycling system similar to paid tools like Edgar. Users populate a Google Sheets content library with their updates, set a posting schedule in Buffer, and Alchemist continuously pulls from that library to keep social profiles active. The bot refills the schedule endlessly without requiring ongoing input, helping users maintain a consistent social media presence. It is built for marketers, bloggers, and creators who want to automate social media without paying for premium tools.
Automatically recycle evergreen blog posts and links across social media profiles
Keep social media accounts active without daily manual scheduling
Replace expensive tools like Edgar using a free Buffer account
Manage a content library in Google Sheets and auto-post on a set schedule

